articles.title: European Soccer Nations Threaten World Cup Boycott Over Fifa's Privatization Plan
articles.summary: In a stunning rebuke, all 55 European soccer associations voted to boycott World Cups if Fifa sells stakes in its tournaments to private investors. The emergency meeting's 'venomous' atmosphere signals a deepening crisis for soccer's governing body.

articles.title: White House Launches 'Freedom Haulers' to Train Veterans as Truckers Amid Immigrant Driver Purge
articles.summary: With 26,000 immigrant drivers removed from U.S. roads for English proficiency failures, the Trump administration is recruiting veterans to fill the gap. A new campaign lets recently discharged military drivers bypass CDL skills tests and offers fully funded training.

articles.title: The Homeownership Dream Fades: Renter-Owner Wealth Gap Hits Record High
articles.summary: Home prices surged to a record $440,600 this summer, widening the wealth chasm between renters and owners to its highest level since 1989. For Millennials like Jay Washington, 38, student debt and soaring costs make buying nearly impossible.
